description: This is a false-colour satellite image acquired on 2011-06-29 by the Spot 5 sensor, illustrating the Nordic Alvar grasslands within the Stora Alvaret Natura 2000 (N2K) site in Sweden. The image uses a 1/2/3 band combination, which renders healthy vegetation in shades of red. The primary area of interest, outlined in yellow, distinctly shows these grasslands in reddish-brown to bright red tones, characteristic of their spectral signature in this band combination. Surrounding the outlined area, darker blue-green vegetation, likely representing forests or denser scrubs, is visible. A small black water body is present on the left side of the image. A linear road feature runs along the right edge, with a small red-coloured patch adjacent to it. The imagery has a spatial resolution of 2.5 meters.
